_question: which players can a three-way weekly grade actually compare?
_limit: SEASON projections used as the pre-season proxy for the WEEKLY universes. Re-test at week 1 from real weekly snapshots.

k_def.note: FantasyPros publishes no K/DEF here, so a THREE-way grade structurally cannot include them. This is not our gap to close; a two-way grade against Sleeper could.

primary_three_way.why: the only set all three sources price; nested, so no partial-overlap adjudication is needed

secondary_two_way_vs_sleeper.why: what the wider universe does, where FantasyPros cannot follow. Reported beside the primary, never instead of it.
